note: Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest campground on the strip of land between 16-acre West Twin Lake and 22-acre East Twin Lake, 8 miles west of Washburn on the Bayfield Peninsula. Both lakes are closed to motors; there are swimming spots along the shore. Blueberry picking in the Moquah Barrens in late summer; the Valhalla trails and the Long Lake beach are nearby. ATVs and UTVs may not be ridden in the campground. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API, RIDB catalog and the FS page read. $15 confirmed (doubles $30); season May 1 - Oct 15 with reservations only in the summer peak, FCFS otherwise; 16 sites, 10 reservable, posted RV lengths 25-40 ft (stored 45 is the vehicle length, not the RV limit).
